name: "Frontend Lint & Compile check"
on:
  workflow_call:

  BUN_CACHE_SALT: 2026-10-20-test-runners
jobs:
  lint:
    timeout-minutes: 3
    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404

      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          # Pinned: bun generates yarn.lock (bunfig print = "yarn") and the output
          # changes between bun versions, which trips the lint job's dirty-tree check.
          bun-version-file: frontend/.bun-version
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          # Matches package.json engines; native deps (isolated-vm) ship no Node 20 prebuilds.
          node-version-file: frontend/.nvmrc
      - name: Restore dependency cache
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: frontend/node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ env.BUN_CACHE_SALT }}-${{ hashFiles('frontend/yarn.lock', 'frontend/package.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ env.BUN_CACHE_SALT }}-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Get Biome version
        id: biome-version
        run: echo "version=$(jq -r '.devDependencies["@biomejs/biome"]' package.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Setup Biome
        uses: biomejs/setup-biome@v2
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.biome-version.outputs.version }}
      - name: Check Ultracite setup
        run: bun x ultracite doctor
      - name: Run Biome/Ultracite

          bun run lint

            echo "::error::Lint produced uncommitted changes. Run 'bun run lint' locally and commit the result."
            echo "$CHANGED"
            exit 1
          fi

  type-check:
    timeout-minutes: 3
    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:

    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404

      run:
        working-directory: frontend

        uses: actions/checkout@v6

        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
